easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing Forests, Mountains and/or Plains other than Magus of the Candelabra.
description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
